# Basis Universal transcoder (prebuilt)

- Files: `basis_transcoder.js`, `basis_transcoder.wasm`.
- Source: three.js npm package `three@0.185.1`,
  `examples/jsm/libs/basis/` (prebuilt copy of the official
  Binomial LLC Basis Universal transcoder).
- Upstream: https://github.com/BinomialLLC/basis_universal
- License: Apache-2.0 (Basis Universal); three.js distribution is MIT.
- Role: studio tool dependency for the pack inspector's texture previews.
  Not a game asset; never shipped into game builds.
